description: How the normalized per-clause scores are combined into one score per document.

enum.name: arithmetic_mean
enum.description: Weighted mean. Rewards a document that scores strongly on any one clause, and halves the score of a document matching only one of two clauses.

enum.name: harmonic_mean
enum.description: Weighted harmonic mean. Penalizes a document that scores weakly on any clause, favouring documents that match every clause.

enum.name: geometric_mean
enum.description: Weighted geometric mean. Penalizes a document that scores weakly on any clause, favouring documents that match every clause.
